input: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 0.25% on Wednesday, marking the tenth consecutive increase. Chair Jerome Powell signaled that future hikes would depend on incoming economic data. Markets reacted positively, with the S&P 500 rising 1.2%.
expected: The Fed raised rates by 0.25% for the tenth straight time. Powell said future decisions depend on economic data. Stocks rose.

input: Apple announced the iPhone 16 at its annual September event, featuring a new A18 chip with on-device AI capabilities. The device starts at $799 and ships October 1. Pre-orders begin Friday.
expected: Apple unveiled the iPhone 16 with an A18 AI chip, priced from $799, shipping October 1 with pre-orders starting Friday.

input: A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck central Turkey early Monday, killing at least 14 people and injuring over 200. Rescue teams are searching collapsed buildings in three provinces. The government declared a state of emergency.
expected: A 6.2 magnitude earthquake in central Turkey killed 14 and injured 200+. Rescue operations are underway and a state of emergency was declared.

input: Tesla reported Q3 earnings that beat analyst expectations, with revenue of $25.2 billion and vehicle deliveries of 435,000 units. CEO Elon Musk announced plans to begin Cybertruck deliveries in November.
expected: Tesla beat Q3 expectations with $25.2B revenue and 435K deliveries. Musk confirmed Cybertruck deliveries start in November.

input: Researchers at MIT published a study showing that a new mRNA vaccine reduced flu infections by 89% in clinical trials involving 5,000 participants. Side effects were mild and comparable to existing flu vaccines.
expected: MIT researchers found their new mRNA flu vaccine reduced infections by 89% in a 5,000-person trial with mild side effects.
